items.title: Lemma 4: uniform comparison of W and delta^{-1}W tube scales
items.statement_scope: Complete Lemma 3 (label mainlemma): suppose l_{j,a} are lines in R^n with angle at most delta from the x_j-axis; let T_{j,a,W} be the characteristic function of the W-neighborhood of l_{j,a} and f_{j,W}=sum_a T_{j,a,W}. If S >= delta^{-1} W and Q_S is any cube of side length S, then the integral over Q_S of the product of f_{j,W}^{1/(n-1)} is at most C_n delta^n times the integral over Q_S of the product of f_{j,delta^{-1}W}^{1/(n-1)}. Complete proof included.
